title: Reasoning about In-Context Samples for Machine-Translation
abstract: arXiv:2608.27036v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can be trained to perform chain-of-thoughts reasoning in order to improve the reliability of their responses. In this work, we investigate how explicit reasoning can be leveraged for LLM-Based Machine Translation (MT) with in-context samples. We introduce a novel fragment-based reasoning framework in which the model first extracts parallel source-target fragments from retrieved similar exemplars, and uses these fragments as intermediate reasoning traces to produce the final translation. To train our model, we distill silver fragments and drafts from a large teacher model. Our experiments with the Qwen3 model family, over 6 languages, including up to 5 domains per language, demonstrate that fragment-based MT significantly outperforms alternative methods like standard k-shot or basic drafting.

translated_title: 关于机器翻译中上下文样本推理的研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.27036v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大型语言模型（LLMs）可以通过训练进行思维链推理，以提高其响应的可靠性。在这项工作中，我们研究了如何利用显式推理来增强基于LLM的机器翻译（MT）中的上下文样本。我们引入了一种新颖的基于片段的推理框架，其中模型首先从检索到的相似示例中提取平行的源-目标片段，并将这些片段作为中间推理轨迹来生成最终翻译。为了训练我们的模型，我们从大型教师模型中提炼出银级片段和草稿。我们在Qwen3模型系列上进行的实验，覆盖6种语言，每种语言最多5个领域，表明基于片段的机器翻译显著优于标准k-shot或基础草稿等替代方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于片段的推理框架，通过从相似示例中提取平行片段作为中间推理步骤，显著提升了LLM在机器翻译中的表现。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a fragment-based reasoning framework that extracts parallel fragments from similar exemplars as intermediate reasoning steps, significantly improving LLM-based machine translation performance.
